headline: Hormuud Telecom Operates 11 Data Centers and Expands 5G in Somalia
summary: Hormuud Telecom has grown into a major telecommunications operator in Somalia, serving millions with 11 data centers, 18,000 shareholders, and a growing 5G network.
why: Telecommunications infrastructure expansion in frontier markets drives digital financial inclusion, mobile money adoption, and broadband service penetration.

impacts.name: Telecommunications
impacts.why: Expansion of data centers and 5G networks increases subscriber data usage and digital service revenues.
